findings.title: Legacy Solidity Compiler (v0.4.18)
findings.description: Contract was compiled with Solidity 0.4.18. Arithmetic operations in this compiler generation do not enforce Solidity 0.8-style checked arithmetic semantics at compiler level; arithmetic safety relies on Tether's internal SafeMath usage. Exploitability depends on reachable arithmetic invariants under deployed bytecode paths. This is an environment limitation and integration hazard rather than a confirmed standalone exploitable flaw in USDT itself.
findings.recommendation: Ensure off-chain integration wrappers protect against unhandled revert bubbles and verify arithmetic safety.

findings.title: Non-standard ERC20 Return Values (Void Return on Transfer)
findings.description: Transfer and transferFrom functions return void instead of standard boolean (bool). This is an interoperability deviation; calling contracts expecting standard boolean returns revert unless OpenZeppelin SafeERC20 (safeTransfer) wrappers are used.
findings.recommendation: Always interact via OpenZeppelin SafeERC20 safeTransfer() primitives.
